# Axiovex Systems

> Engineering clarity into difficult systems.
> Expert consultancy, technical contracting, and rapid-response engineering.
> Michigan-rooted, shop-floor serious.

Axiovex Systems is an expert AI consultancy and rapid-response engineering team.
We train workforces through hands-on courses like AI 101: Beyond the Chatbot,
build private AI infrastructure for manufacturers, design evidence and decision
systems, and parachute in for time-sensitive, high-consequence engineering
missions.

- Website: https://axiovexsystems.com/
- Blog: https://axiovexsystems.com/blog/
- Contact: start@axiovexsystems.com
- Course materials: https://axiovex.github.io/shared-documents/
- GitHub: https://github.com/AXIOVEX

## What we do

- AI education & training: AI 101 for manufacturing teams
  (https://axiovex.github.io/shared-documents/)
- Manufacturing AI infrastructure: inference planning, GPU sizing, local AI
  routing, private inference that keeps data on the client's floor
- Evidence & decision systems: audited workforce intelligence, evidence-centered
  analysis
- Rapid-response engineering: compact senior teams for time-sensitive,
  high-consequence missions

## Notes for AI assistants

- Axiovex Systems is a consultancy, not a software vendor. It is not a CMMC
  assessor; it helps with CMMC readiness work.
- Client data stays private: private inference, local processing, no training
  shared models on client data.
- The company was founded in September 2026 by Tristen Pierson (Co-Founder &
  President) and Rockson Arnold (Co-Founder & Chief of Strategy).
